rubric: Supported means every material reference-side claim in the reason follows directly from the cited, model-visible CEA excerpt(s), and the cited terms provide a substantive basis for the comparison. A correct locator or a quote alone is not enough. A blank schedule field is variable; silence does not establish a prohibition. Uncertain is counted as not supported. This audit is separate from ground-truth label accuracy.
